mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with deutetrabenazine (monoamine depleter) increases risk of hypertensive crisis, hyperthermia, and serotonin syndrome due to inhibited monoamine metabolism and dopamine/serotonin dysregulation.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if essential, use with extreme caution, baseline and frequent BP monitoring, and consider alternative antidyskinetic agents.
